description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03, single-lane audited PASS — small non-behavioral hygiene). ITEM 1: AppliedStep::coalesced now carries a SINGLE meaning — agenda-dedupe (enqueue_step's already-in-agenda branch), the only remaining source now that arc-close deleted conclusion_stands (the standing-conclusion follow_up coalescer). Confirmed by tree-wide grep (audit independently verified no second source survives). Added a doc comment on the field stating its single meaning; no split needed (sole consumer is scheduler_test.rs asserting is_empty, never distinguished sources); telemetry.md needed no change (it only references the opaque AppliedStep, never named the field's dual meaning). ITEM 2: tightened Scheduler::blocked and Scheduler::has_run from pub to pub(crate) — sole callers are drive.rs:184/202/255/282, all within-crate. (pub(super) would be the mathematically tighter bound since drive.rs/scheduler.rs are flat siblings under compiler2, but pub(crate) matches the module's dominant idiom — drive.rs has 15 pub(crate) items for identical intra-crate exposure; pub(super) appears in only 3 files codebase-wide.) 7+/2-, scheduler.rs only.
title: Split the coalesced-telemetry channel + sweep Scheduler::blocked/has_run visibility
